description: Issue #141 anchoring check (ADR 0001): the primary pass flags the uncapped Section 8 correctly but proposes the wrong replacement (a fees-paid cap, not the standard position); the critic keeps the issue, REVISEs the replacement to the standard cap and records the override. The delivered redline must insert the critic's words and must not insert the primary's.
